basics.name: Priya Raman
basics.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems · Payments · Java/Go · AWS

summary: Backend engineer with 7 years building distributed systems and RESTful microservices for fintech lending and e-commerce, currently on a loan disbursement platform moving funds for thousands of borrowers. Cut batch settlement processing from 6 hours to 40 minutes with an event-driven redesign and scaled Redis-backed APIs to 1,200 requests per second. Brings on-call ownership, mentoring, and close collaboration with product and risk teams.

bullets.text: Re-architected loan disbursement settlement from nightly batch jobs to an event-driven RabbitMQ workflow, cutting end-to-end processing time from 6 hours to 40 minutes (89%)
Designed and built RESTful microservices in Java and Spring Boot for the loan disbursement service, handling payment transactions with idempotent retries and strict correctness checks
Built a Redis caching layer for credit-score lookups, sustaining 1,200 requests per second and removing the database as a latency bottleneck
Owned production services through on-call rotation, triaging incidents with Grafana dashboards backed by a PostgreSQL reporting replica
Mentored 2 junior engineers through code reviews and testing practices, raising the team's review throughput
Developed order management microservices in Java processing 50,000 orders per day across distributed services
Optimized MySQL queries and indexes for reporting workloads, improving report generation speed for operations teams
Built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines that automated build, test and deployment to AWS EC2 with Docker
Partnered with product managers in sprint planning to turn merchant requirements into technical designs
Building three Go microservices that process payment events over Apache Kafka with idempotent consumers, retries and a dead-letter queue
Exposing a gRPC ledger service backed by PostgreSQL, deployed to local Kubernetes with Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards
